mapper.sql: id, scene_voucher_id, fund_type, relate_bank_flag, bank_account, cash_attribute, voucher_summary, client_flag, contract_flag, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag
mapper.select: select distinct esve.assist_flags from eg_scene_voucher esv join eg_scene es on esv.scene_id = es.id and es.del_flag = '0' join eg_scene_voucher_entry esve on esve.scene_voucher_id = esv.id and esve.del_flag = '0' where es.scene_code = #{sceneCode}

select es.scene_code sceneCode, esve.assist_flags assistFlags from eg_scene es left join eg_scene_voucher esv on esv.scene_id = es.id and esv.del_flag = '0' left join eg_scene_voucher_entry esve on esve.scene_voucher_id = esv.id and esve.del_flag = '0' where es.del_flag = '0'
